extracted.intended_audience: academics, researchers, contributors, editors, and general readers interested in The Conversation's editorial standards
extracted.subtask_description: An organizational editorial charter describing The Conversation's standards and commitments for producing and curating knowledge-based journalism, protecting editorial independence, managing partnerships and advertising, and ensuring quality, accountability and public benefit. It is intended to guide contributors, editors and partners in content production and governance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inform public debate with knowledge-based journalism
rubrics_metrics.description: Inform public debate with knowledge-based journalism that is responsible, ethical and supported by evidence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Produce journalism grounded in evidence; prioritize responsibility and ethical standards when informing public debate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unlock the knowledge of researchers and academics
rubrics_metrics.description: Unlock the knowledge of researchers and academics to provide the public with clarity and insight into society’s biggest problems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize contributions from researchers and academics to explain complex issues and offer clear insight into major societal problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide a platform for experts to share knowledge
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a platform where experts around the world can share knowledge, discuss problems and identify sustainable solutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Facilitate global expert dialogue focused on discussing problems and identifying sustainable, evidence-based solutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fact-based and editorially independent forum
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a fact-based and editorially independent forum, free of commercial or political bias.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain strict editorial independence and ensure content is fact-based; actively avoid commercial or political bias in coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support and foster academic freedom
rubrics_metrics.description: Support and foster academic freedom to conduct research, teach, write and publish.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Protect contributors' academic freedom so they can research, teach, write and publish without undue constraint or censorship.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-partisan sponsorship and non-obtrusive advertising
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure the site’s integrity by only obtaining non-partisan sponsorship from education, government and private partners. Any advertising will be relevant and non-obtrusive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accept only non-partisan sponsorship; ensure advertising is relevant to audiences and does not intrude on or compromise editorial content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protect editorial freedom in commercial agreements
rubrics_metrics.description: Protect editorial freedom in all commercial agreements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure commercial partnerships and contracts do not infringe on editorial decision-making or content independence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use experienced editors to ensure quality and reach
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure quality, diverse and intelligible content reaches the widest possible audience by employing experienced editors to curate the site.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Employ experienced editors to curate content for quality, diversity, clarity, and broad accessibility to maximize audience reach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adhere to journalism best practice; correct errors
rubrics_metrics.description: Set the standard in journalism best practice. Be open, transparent and accountable. Where errors occur correct them expeditiously.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commit to transparency and accountability, follow recognized journalism best practices, and correct mistakes quickly and openly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operate for the public good with partners and advisory board
rubrics_metrics.description: Work with our academic, business and government partners and our advisory board to ensure we are operating for the public good.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engage partners and an advisory board to keep organizational operations and editorial policies aligned with the public interest.
